title: Over the Teacups
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes
description: "Over the Teacups" by Oliver Wendell Holmes is a collection of essays presented in a conversational format, likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The work serves as a reflection on various topics of life, culture, and the author’s personal experiences as he engages a diverse group of characters around a metaphorical tea table.

authorInfo.bio: Oliver Wendell Holmes (1809–1894) wrote The Autocrat of the Breakfast-Table. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
